results.HOLD_EXPLAIN: Measured in the 1.6 s window once you settle on the pose mark. Stillness is the RMS drift of your head position in cm (the verdict band scales it to a 1.60 m reference height); mark accuracy is your average position vs the mark in cm. Head sensor only - nothing reads your expression or styling. The tightening light pool and the flash surge follow these measured numbers.
